name: adlock
description: A local-first Manifest V3 algorithmic ad blocker.

scripts.test: node --test tests/engine.test.mjs tests/navigation-guard.test.mjs tests/privacy-guard.test.mjs tests/rules.test.mjs tests/runtime-bridge.test.mjs tests/service-worker.test.mjs && node scripts/validate.mjs
scripts.release: npm test && npm run benchmark:assert && node scripts/package-release.mjs
